nom: Vichy Mineral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, sometimes aging skin describe strong overnight hydration, with skin feeling softer, plumper and less tight or flaky by morning.
segments.combination: Reports are mixed for combination skin: several reviewers say it absorbs well without breakouts or greasiness, while one says the cream sat on top of her skin instead of soaking in and did not feel especially moisturizing.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally tolerate the cream without burning or breakouts, and one reports a persistent rash clearing up, though a few single out the strong fragrance as the one thing that bothers them.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 50s use it mainly for hydration and mild firming, reporting softer, plumper skin and slightly less visible fine lines rather than dramatic wrinkle reduction.

concerns.aging: Reviewers targeting fine lines describe modest, gradual softening rather than dramatic change; some say they would need an extra product step or more time to see real results, while others in their 40s-50s report visibly plumper, smoother skin around the mouth and eyes.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those with dry skin, report strong overnight hydration and a plump, refreshed feel by morning; one reviewer with combination skin says the cream sat on top of her skin instead of absorbing and did not feel especially moisturizing.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers credit the cream with strengthening or supporting their skin barrier alongside its hydrating effect.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports no redness or breakouts on her sensitive skin, and another describes a stubborn itchy rash on her cheeks clearing up after about a week of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or combination skin, report no new breakouts; one reviewer with sensitive skin says the cream was too thick for her and she broke out with acne overnight during the first few uses.

aspects.libelle: Can pill or leave slight sticky residue
Strong value for the price point
Melatonin content may aid falling asleep

extraits.texte: This cream is very luxurious. The texture, is so nice and thick. I love the feeling on my skin. I do have sensitive skin and this did not burn putting it on, and has a pleasant and not overpowering smell. Unfortunately though I think it was a bit too thick for my skin as I broke out with some acne overnight the first few times I y not be able to use it. But if your skin isn't sensitive, I would reccommend as it is highly moisturizing!

extraits.titre: Not as moisturizing as I would've hoped.
extraits.texte: I used the Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream in my nightly routine, and honestly, it's just okay. I have combination skin, and instead of soaking in, it kind of just sat on top of my face. It's not super moisturizing, and while it's not bad, it's not something I'd reach for again. I'm used to thicker, richer night creams that leave my skin looking hydrated and refreshed, and this one didn't really do that. My skin felt dull and not as rejuvenated as I hoped. Just keeping it real.

extraits.titre: A wonderful night cream that leaves skin soft
extraits.texte: My skin has changed recently. It used to be really oily, and lately I would say that it is combination and definitely aging (I'm in my mid-40's). I have been looking for a moisturizer that makes my skin feel recovered in the morning, a good mix of hydration, protective barrier, and something that works quickly. I like that it's lightly fragranced as so many moisturizers are heavily scented which bothers me, especially at night. I also find that it absorbs super-quickly without leaving a greasy texture behind. The only reason I gave it four stars is because I feel like there may be an additional step needed for fine lines. But for the price point, I do like it and recommend it.

I've been searching for a facial cream that truly hydrates without feeling heavy or greasy, and I finally found it. This cream is incredibly soothing on my dry, sensitive skin and has made a noticeable difference in just a couple of weeks. My skin feels softer, smoother, and looks more radiant — even the fine lines around my mouth and eyes seem less pronounced. What I love most is the texture. It's rich but absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling plump and hydrated all day. There's no irritation, no fragrance overload, and it layers well under makeup. I use it morning and night, and I've noticed that my skin no longer feels tight or flaky by midday. For anyone dealing with dryness, flakiness, or that dull feeling that often comes with aging skin, I can't recommend this enough. It feels like a spa treatment in a jar — gentle, effective, and worth every penny.

I received a free sample of this product in exchange for my honest review. I've been using it every night for a little over a week now and my skin looks fantastic. Initially, I thought the smell was floral and overpowering, but now I actually find it soothing and to be part of my bedtime routine. My skin looks glowy and plump when I wake up in the morning. I also have sensitive skin and have been dealing with a very stubborn itchy rash on my upper cheeks since February. A week of using this and it's gone! I will definitely recommend this product to others and will be purchasing for myself. I love it so much I even ordered the day cream!

I have very acne prone skin even at 39 years old. This didn't agitate my skin in any way and it seems to be a bit plumper in any fine line areas since I've started using it a week and a half ago. Bonus points for not feeling heavy or sticky!
